cards.audioText: Your call sign is AFR971, you are passing 3900m for 3600m. Contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是法航971，你正在通过3900米，下降3600米。联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航971，离开3900米，下降3600米。

cards.audioText: AFR971, Wuhan Approach, radar identified, information E valid, descend and maintain 3000m on QNH 1004.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，武汉进近，雷达已识别，通播E有效，下降保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1004。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 3000m on QNH 1004, information E, AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1004，通播E，法航971。

cards.audioText: AFR971, descend and maintain 2400m, reduced to minimum clean speed.[Read back the instructions and tell the controller that the clean configuration speed of your aircraft is 200 knots.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，下降保持2400米，减速到最小光洁速度。【复诵指令，告诉管制员飞机的最小襟翼收上速度是200节。】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 2400m, the minimum speed 200 knots. AFR971
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持2400米，最小速度是200节，法航971。

cards.audioText: AFR971, turn right heading 300. You are No.3, 25 miles from touch-down.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，右转航向300。你是第三个，距离接地还有25海里。【复诵】

cards.audioText: AFR971, turn left proceed direct to DA, descend and maintain 2100m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，左转直飞DA，下降保持2100米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, descend and maintain 2100m, AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，下降保持2100米，法航971。

cards.audioText: AFR971, hold at DA as published.[Read back the controller's instructions. And ask the reason for the hold.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，在DA标准等待。【复诵管制员的指令。询问等待的原因。】
cards.referenceText: Holding at DA as published, What's the reason for the hold? AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在DA标准等待，等待的原因是什么？法航971。

cards.audioText: AFR971, runway inspection in progress at the moment, expect delay more than 15min.[Read back the ATC instructions, report that you are entering the hold and hold no more than 15min.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，正在测试跑道，预计延误15分钟以上。【复诵ATC的指令并报告其你已经进入等待点，等待不超过15分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Entering the holding pattern, and hold no more than 15min, AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 已进入等待程序，等待不能超过15分钟，法航971。

cards.audioText: The EGT of your starboard engine is fluctuating, state this situation to the controller. Ask to leave the holding pattern right away.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机右侧发动机的排气温度不稳定，把这一情况报告给管制员。请求立刻离开等待航线。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR971, The EGT of the right engine is fluctuating, request leave the holding pattern now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航971。右侧发动机的排气温度不稳定，请求现在离开等待程序。

cards.audioText: AFR971, roger, standby, continue hold, we are changing the landing sequences, expect to call you in 2min.[The oil pressure of your starboard engine is rapidly decreasing, state this situation to the controller, request immediate exit and request descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，收到，稍等，继续等待，我们正在更改着陆顺序，预计2分钟内叫你。【右侧发动机的油压快速下降，向管制员报告该情况，请求立即退出等待程序并下降。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR971, the oil pressure of the right engine is rapidly decreasing, request immediate exit hold and descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航971，右侧发动机的油压快速下降，请求立即退出等待程序并下降。

cards.audioText: AFR971, standby, traffic at your 3 o'clock maintaining 1800m crossing from your right to left, report visual.[Tell the controller you have seen the conflicting aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，稍等，你3点钟方向，高度1800米，有一架飞机正在从你右侧穿越到左侧，能见报告。【告诉管制员你已经看到了冲突航空器。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR971, traffic in sight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航971，看到航空器了。

cards.audioText: Your starboard engine has failed, make an urgency call, and ask for landing priority.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机右侧发动机失效，做紧急呼叫，并申请优先降落。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, AFR971, our right engine has failed, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉进近，法航971，飞机右侧发动机失效，请求优先降落。

cards.audioText: AFR971, roger PANPAN. Turn left heading 060, descend and maintain 900m, cleared to ILS approach runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，收到PANPAN。左转航向060，下降保持900米，可以盲降进近跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Left heading 060, descend and maintain 900m, cleared to ILS approach runway 36L, AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向060，下降保持900米，可以盲降进近跑道36左，法航971。

cards.audioText: AFR971, contact Wuhan Tower, frequency 124.35 good bye.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，武汉塔台，频率124.35，再见。

cards.audioText: Your heading is 060 and your altitude is 900m, contact Wuhan Tower and tell him about the condition of your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的航向是060，高度900米，联系武汉塔台，告诉其飞机目前情况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR971, heading 060, altitude 900m, our right engine has failed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航971，航向060，高度900米，飞机右侧发动机失效。

cards.audioText: AFR971, Wuhan Tower, roger, maintain present heading.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，武汉塔台，收到，保持当前航向。【复诵】

cards.audioText: AFR971, turn left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for runway 36L.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，左转航向030切入跑道36左航道。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for runway 36L, AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向030切入跑道36左航道，法航971。

cards.audioText: Report you have established localizer runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 【报告你已经建立了跑道36左航道。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR971, established localizer runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，跑道36左航道已经建立。

cards.audioText: AFR971, cleared to land, wind 300/5mps.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，可以着陆，风300，5米/秒。【复诵】
